measure: authoritative compiler decisions moved to XAX, not Python lines removed

blake3.py.note: Hash reference; on Linux x86-64 blake3() runs the S2 XAX hash, this is the fallback and differential oracle.

xax_native.py.note: Maps XAX-lowered images into the Python process (W^X, cache, authority record); decides no compiler question.

xax_native_blake3.py.note: S0 compressor builder; its image comes from the optimizing bootstrap backend.

xax_optimizer.py.note: M12 validated-search prototype; no production build path imports it, so it holds no production authority (YAGNI until a build uses it).

xax_riscv64.py.note: Bootstrap reference for the S5 XAX RISC-V backend. Since S7b.2, _object_table and image_record only copy words: the XAX programs resolve references, pick the target and entry, and produce the image record.

xax_selfhost.py.note: M14 semantic-image wrapper and bootstrap_status derivation.

xax_selfhost_blake3.py.note: Builder of the canonical S2 store (the store is authoritative).

xax_selfhost_compiler.py.note: The production compiler's canonical build request, derived from the general driver store (S14b, ADR-285).

xax_selfhost_cfg.py.note: Builder of the canonical S3d store.

xax_selfhost_driver.py.note: Builder of the canonical S10 driver store (ADR-265, ADR-266) and of the S12e.2 general driver store (ADR-276).

xax_selfhost_semantic.py.note: Builder of the S10e semantic-verification marshal functions inside the driver store (ADR-266).

xax_selfhost_seed.py.note: Pins of the XAX-built Linux x86-64 compiler seed (bootstrap/seed/) and its rotation; it builds nothing itself (S15a, ADR-286).

xax_selfhost_request.py.note: Builder of the S13a build-request and provenance functions inside the general driver store (ADR-281).

xax_selfhost_resolve.py.note: Builder of the S13c package-resolution and snapshot functions inside the general driver store (ADR-283).

xax_selfhost_render.py.note: Builder of the store verifier's rendering phase (its rejections as the bootstrap's diagnostics, verify_store's order) and the host's reference rendering for tests (S15b.1, ADR-288).

xax_selfhost_render_types.py.note: Builder of the driver's type and constant rejection renderer (S15b.2, ADR-289).

xax_selfhost_general_rejects.py.note: Builder of the general x86-64 program's code generation rejections with the bootstrap's diagnostics (S15b.4, ADR-294).

xax_selfhost_render_graph.py.note: Builder of the typing program's graph outcome function (_parse_graph's order, the deciding record) and its host decoder (S15b.3a, ADR-292).

xax_selfhost_diagnostics.py.note: S7b record builders (emit XAX nodes) and the host renderer, which decides nothing.

xax_selfhost_facts.py.note: Builder of the facts engine inside the typing store.

xax_selfhost_graph.py.note: Builder of the canonical S3c store.

xax_selfhost_riscv64.py.note: Builder of the canonical S1 store.

xax_selfhost_riscv64_backend.py.note: Builder of the canonical S5 store.

xax_selfhost_store.py.note: Builder of the canonical S3 store.

xax_selfhost_target.py.note: Builder of the target.op engine inside the typing store.

xax_selfhost_typing.py.note: Builder of the canonical S4 store.

xax_selfhost_verify.py.note: Builder of the canonical S6 store.

xax_selfhost_views_backend.py.note: Shared builder half of the S5/S7 stores, plus the in-process native runner.

xax_selfhost_x86_64_backend.py.note: Builder of the canonical S7 store; image_from_backend_output renders the program's image record (S7b.2).

xax_selfhost_x86_64_general.py.note: Builder of the canonical S12 general x86-64 backend store; S12a front end (ADR-268).

xax_selfhost_general_view.py.note: Builder of the S12b lowering view in the general x86-64 backend store (ADR-269).

xax_selfhost_general_ranges.py.note: Builder of the S12c.1 value ranges and prefetch selection in the general x86-64 backend store (ADR-270).

xax_selfhost_general_regalloc.py.note: Builder of the S12c.2 register-resident analyses in the general x86-64 backend store (ADR-271).

xax_selfhost_general_emit.py.note: Builder of the S12d register-resident emission in the general x86-64 backend store (ADR-272).

xax_selfhost_general_image.py.note: Builder of the S12e image assembly and Linux ELF64 container in the general x86-64 backend store (ADR-273).

xax_selfhost_general_frame.py.note: Builder of the S12f frame lowering in the general x86-64 backend store (ADR-275).

xax_selfhost_general_legacy.py.note: Builder of the S12f.4 legacy register path in the general x86-64 backend store (ADR-280).

xax_selfhost_writer.py.note: Builder of the canonical S9 store (ADR-262).

xax_views_lowering.py.note: Shared analysis of the views bootstrap references and the single LOWERED_OPERATIONS list; on Linux x86-64 the XAX programs decide views legality for both families (S7b.1, S7b.3).

xax_local_protocol.py.note: Snapshot-bound request transport, exact compound expansion and verified construction adapter; canonical verification and atomic publication remain in Workspace/semantic constructors.

xax_contract.py.note: xax-host-contract-v1 (ADR-225): names and format identities external integrations may depend on; no compiler logic.

xax_prefetch.py.note: Lowering-view next-iteration prefetch (ADR-211): pure index copy, proven-in-bounds load, prefetch hints; canonical program unchanged.

xax_selfhost_ed25519.py.note: Builder of the XAX SHA-512 and Ed25519 verification functions inside the general driver store (S15c.3, ADR-301).

xax_selfhost_edit.py.note: Builder of the XAX transaction engine inside the general driver store (S15d.1, ADR-304); apply_reference is its Python reference.

xax_selfhost_evolution.py.note: The evolution ledger: applies the committed transactions to the builder baseline and derives records from read-only queries (S15d.2, ADR-305).

xax_selfhost_aarch64_emit.py.note: Builder of the S15e.2 AArch64 program store: the instruction encoders (ADR-315).

xax_selfhost_aarch64_frame.py.note: Builder of the S15e.2b AArch64 program store: the frame path (ADR-316, ADR-325).

xax_selfhost_aarch64_general.py.note: Builder of the canonical S15e.2 AArch64 program store; its front end and bare-metal images (ADR-315, ADR-325).

xax_selfhost_aarch64_image.py.note: Builder of the S15e.2 AArch64 program store: the bundle and the ELF image (ADR-315).

xax_selfhost_aarch64_legacy.py.note: Builder of the S15f.4 AArch64 legacy register path in the AArch64 program store (ADR-325).

xax_selfhost_aarch64_lower.py.note: Builder of the S15e.2 AArch64 lowering views in the AArch64 program store (ADR-315).

xax_selfhost_general_accel.py.note: Builder of the S15e.7a accelerator deployments in the general x86-64 backend store (ADR-321).

xax_selfhost_general_dll.py.note: Builder of the S15e.3b Windows DLL plan and image in the general x86-64 backend store (ADR-320).

xax_selfhost_general_spirv.py.note: Builder of the S15e.7b SPIR-V modules in the general x86-64 backend store (ADR-321).

xax_selfhost_general_wasm.py.note: Builder of the S15e.4 and S15f.1 Wasm modules in the general x86-64 backend store (ADR-322, ADR-324).

xax_selfhost_jvm.py.note: Builder of the canonical S15e.5 JVM program store; front end, class file and JAR (ADR-327-ADR-331).

xax_selfhost_jvm_aggregate.py.note: Builder of the S15e.5f aggregates and sums in the JVM program store (ADR-332).

xax_selfhost_jvm_callback.py.note: Builder of the S15e.5e callbacks in the JVM program store (ADR-331).

xax_selfhost_jvm_class.py.note: Builder of the S15e.5 class-file buffers and constant pool in the JVM program store (ADR-327).

xax_selfhost_jvm_code.py.note: Builder of the S15e.5 code buffer in the JVM program store (ADR-327).

xax_selfhost_jvm_emit.py.note: Builder of the S15e.5 edge copies, layout and blocks in the JVM program store (ADR-327).

xax_selfhost_jvm_foreign.py.note: Builder of the S15e.5c references and platform calls in the JVM program store (ADR-329, ADR-330).

xax_selfhost_jvm_lower.py.note: Builder of the S15e.5 node lowering in the JVM program store (ADR-327).

xax_selfhost_jvm_method.py.note: Builder of the S15e.5 method analyses in the JVM program store (ADR-327).

xax_selfhost_jvm_memory.py.note: Builder of the S15e.5g-S15e.5i memory and general profiles and the threaded launcher in the JVM program store (ADR-337, ADR-338).

xax_selfhost_jvm_indirect.py.note: Builder of the S15e.5h indirect-call dispatchers in the JVM program store (ADR-338).

xax_selfhost_apk.py.note: Builder of the S15e.6a APK container program store (ADR-340).

xax_selfhost_apk_signing.py.note: Builder of the S15e.6b APK Signature Scheme v2 signer program store (ADR-341).

xax_selfhost_android_resources.py.note: Builder of the S15e.6c binary manifest and resources.arsc program store (ADR-342).

xax_selfhost_dex.py.note: Builder of the S15e.6d DEX 039 bridge program store (ADR-343, ADR-344, ADR-345).

xax_selfhost_android_elf.py.note: Builder of the S15e.6e Android AArch64 shared object container program store (ADR-346).

xax_selfhost_android_rules.py.note: Builder of the S15e.6f.1 unsigned Android carrier decisions program store (ADR-347); its host part extracts the carriers' decoded facts.

xax_selfhost_android_managed_rules.py.note: Builder of the S15e.6f.2 managed-class Android profile decisions program store (ADR-348); its host part extracts the classes, export interfaces and reachable platform uses.

views-object-table.python_authority: none: xax_riscv64._object_table copies objects in store order with CID words (S7b.2)
views-object-table.differential_oracle: byte-identical images for every helper store on both backends
views-object-table.fixed_point_relevance: on the path of every helper image

views-image-assembly.python_authority: none: image_record renders the program's CIDs and code ranges (S7b.2)
views-image-assembly.fixed_point_relevance: the image record is part of every helper build

store-codec.python_authority: none on the production path (S9, ADR-262): off Linux x86-64 and for inputs the writer's batch cannot carry or its capacity exceeds (a CID or reference not 32 bytes, a field outside 0..2^64, over 65,536 objects, 4,096 records, or a 16 MiB store), xax_compiler._bootstrap_store_contents and _bootstrap_emit_store decide; they remain the differential oracle. SemanticObject.create still proposes each object's CID in Python (preimage encoding; the hash is S2 XAX), which the writer re-derives before it accepts the object
store-codec.xax_hosted: xax_store_writer.xax: schema version, reference order, CID re-derivation (the S2 hash graph over the writer's own view), duplicate CIDs, root presence, record order and duplicates, the container (header, CID-ordered envelopes, metadata envelopes, index, digest, trailer), and the bootstrap's exact rejection messages (ADR-262)
store-codec.differential_oracle: byte-identical stores for every committed store in shuffled order, random stores, and every rejection with its precedence (tests/test_xax_selfhost_writer.py)
store-codec.fixed_point_relevance: required to write the next compiler root

store-decoding.python_authority: xax_compiler.StoreReader and _parse_graph: OBJECT_MISSING lookups, deferred inputs (minor >= 2**32, > 116,507 records, bodies over 1 MiB, accepted values >= 2**35); container (S8a), object-envelope (S8b.1), and graph-syntax (S8b.2) rejections are XAX
store-decoding.xax_hosted: xax_store_decoder.xax and xax_graph_decoder.xax: acceptance and rejections with exact diagnostics (ADR-183 to ADR-185)
store-decoding.differential_oracle: constructed per-rule inputs and mutation corpora against the bootstrap parsers

verifier-acceptance.python_authority: xax_compiler.verify_store (off Linux x86-64 and on declines)
verifier-acceptance.fixed_point_relevance: verifier closes over itself (component fixed point)

verifier-rejection-diagnostics.python_authority: none on the production path (S8, ADR-251): off Linux x86-64 and where an XAX program declines (oversized or unmodelled inputs), xax_compiler's fail() sites decide; they remain the differential oracle
verifier-rejection-diagnostics.xax_hosted: integer, float, compare, aggregate, sum, meta, resource/effect, constant, call-target, and fragment call-contract typing rejections, and stack-memory, checked-access, rebase, returned-view, heap-view, foreign-call, view-passing call, indirect-call stack-proof, atomic, link, address/record, and link-lifetime fact rejections, and constant value, scalar type, compound type, tuple/sum item, pointer element, opaque identity, and malformed constant body rejections: xax_op_typing.xax (S8c.1-S8c.18, S8c.24-S8c.29, ADR-214 to ADR-221, ADR-226 to ADR-230, ADR-232 to ADR-236, ADR-242 to ADR-247); program-root, module, call-contract, function, recursion-group, and target object rejections: xax_store_verifier.xax (S8c.19-S8c.23, ADR-237 to ADR-241); S8 (ADR-251): every remaining rejection: target register lists, profile sections, and enums, the group order, resource transitions, packages and builds, objects read as types, ULEB and store faults, use validity, branch targets, linear flow, atomic attributes, foreign and lend entries, foreign and indirect calls, resource-call and resource-entry contracts, raw loads, address exposure, target.op, the operation vocabulary, decoder-rejected graph prefixes, and checks before an invalid use: xax_op_typing.xax, xax_store_verifier.xax, xax_cfg_analysis.xax
verifier-rejection-diagnostics.differential_oracle: full-suite trace (migration/s8_rejection_trace.py) and live-versus-bootstrap differential (migration/s8_differential.py), per-rule mutation corpora

target-package-interpretation.xax_hosted: partial: views backends read operation/terminator sets

reference-interpreter.fixed_point_relevance: none (reference only, not on the production path)

driver.python_authority: xax_compiler.verify_store / _parse_graph orchestration of semantic verification (S10e); xax_compiler/xax_build call sequences for other targets; the host process that maps the driver image (S11)
driver.xax_hosted: xax_compiler_driver.xax (S10a-S10d, ADR-264, ADR-265): file I/O and owned memory through explicit Linux syscalls, container/digest/object-CID decoding, graph streams, the object table, target-package reading and profile check, XAX backend lowering, image or diagnostic output; equal to compile_x86_64_views on every committed store and a fixed point on its own store
driver.prerequisite: S7b, S8, S9, platform I/O contracts
driver.differential_oracle: compile_x86_64_views on every committed store, the bootstrap container parser and object decoder on mutated stores (tests/test_xax_selfhost_driver.py)

cli.xax_hosted: the general driver process's commands lower and build (S13a, ADR-281), verify and inspect (S13b, ADR-282), resolve (S13c), edit (S15d.1, ADR-304), resolve-trusted (S15c.5, ADR-309); run (the reference interpreter) stays xaxc tooling

x86-64-program-backend.python_authority: xax_x86_64, xax_x86_64_regalloc, xax_linux (register-resident analyses, code generation, image); xax_inline, xax_prefetch, xax_ranges are the S12b/S12c.1 references
x86-64-program-backend.xax_hosted: views subset (xax_x86_64_backend.xax); for the Linux executable profiles (xax_x86_64_general.xax): the S12a front end (target, process entry, closure legality and order, ADR-268), the S12b lowering view (leaf inlining, simplifications, layout, ADR-269), and S12c.1 value ranges and prefetch selection (ADR-270)
x86-64-program-backend.fixed_point_relevance: required for the compiler to emit itself as an ELF executable

artifact-containers.fixed_point_relevance: ELF64 container for the compiler executable

provenance.xax_hosted: for the Linux x86-64 ELF profiles (S13a, ADR-281) and RISC-V raw images (S15e.1, ADR-308): the general driver's build command writes the canonical provenance object (artifact digest and CID by the S2 hash); other targets' provenance stays in xax_build
provenance.differential_oracle: xax_build.build's artifact and provenance envelope, byte for byte (tests/test_xax_selfhost_general_build.py)

build-package-resolution.xax_hosted: the general driver (xax_compiler_driver_general.xax): reading a resolved snapshot for build (S13a, ADR-281); resolve (S13c, ADR-283): package selection by exact root and logical identity with the exact RESOLVE-LOGICAL-IDENTITY rejections, the snapshot object (CID by the S2 hash), and the snapshot store written by the S9 writer; S15c (ADR-299 to ADR-302, ADR-309): profile grants, external input files, Ed25519 package signatures in build, capacities, and resolution under a given trust policy with signatures (resolve-trusted); build effects (Android signing) remain Python
build-package-resolution.differential_oracle: snapshot_store(resolve_packages(...)) bytes and xax_build.build's artifact and provenance (tests/test_xax_selfhost_general_resolve.py, test_xax_selfhost_general_build.py)

platform-contracts.fixed_point_relevance: file I/O for a self-hosted driver

android-backend.python_authority: xax_android*, xax_dex, xax_apk*, xax_manifest, xax_resources, xax_jni, xax_libxposed

graph-construction-tooling.fixed_point_relevance: how compiler stores are produced today: ordinary compiler evolution needs it (B6/SH7 blocker)

workspace-transactions.xax_hosted: S15d.1 (ADR-304): the production compiler's edit command applies SetOperation and SetConstant transactions with Workspace.commit's semantics and cascade, written by the S9 writer; S15d.2-S15d.3 (ADR-305, ADR-306): the committed compiler store is a builder baseline plus the evolution ledger; insertion, deletion, use, signature and function edits remain Python (S15d.4)
